line: A setup wizard installs one summer: the bar crawls under a sinking banded sun, hangs at 99 % in silence, then completes in spinning chrome type before the last dialog is dismissed.
line_cn: 一个安装向导在安装一个夏天：进度条在沉落的条纹夕阳下爬行，静默中卡在 99%，然后以旋转的铬金属字完成，最后点掉最后一个对话框。
uses: Launch teasers, countdowns and loading-screen stories
uses_cn: 怀旧、音乐与专辑风格视觉
时尚、生活方式及青年文化品牌
